meta.author: Muse (library curation)
meta.notes: Standardised verification procedures per project spec section 9. Generic methodology; editorial review status under_review. Related legislation is linked at rule level.

exception_conditions: Missing document that the rule requires
procedures.expected_result: Each document is genuine, complete, and consistent with the underlying transaction.
procedures.followup_procedure: Request missing documents; investigate duplicates before concluding.
procedures.name: Document verification
procedures.objective: Verify that transaction documents are complete, authentic and internally consistent.
steps: Match invoices to contracts and delivery/acceptance records.
Verify the identity and registration details of the supplier/customer.
Check document dates, amounts, tax amounts and reference numbers for consistency.
Identify missing, duplicate or sequentially inconsistent documents.
Conclude whether the document set supports the recorded transaction.

procedures.expected_result: Taxable income reconciles to accounting profit with every difference explained and sourced.
procedures.followup_procedure: Trace each unexplained difference to its source document; quantify the tax effect.
procedures.name: Reconcile accounting profit to taxable income
procedures.objective: Agree accounting profit to the tax computation and explain every difference.
steps: Take profit before tax from the financial statements as the starting point.
List all add-backs (inadmissible expenses, accounting depreciation) with provision references.
List all deductions (tax depreciation, exempt income, allowable allowances).
Foot the computation to taxable income and agree to the return figure.
Document each reconciling item with its evidence reference.

exception_conditions: Revenue in ledger not reported in return
procedures.expected_result: Turnover per the ledger reconciles to turnover per the tax return(s).
procedures.followup_procedure: Investigate unreported revenue; check year-end cut-off.
procedures.name: Reconcile turnover: ledger to tax return
procedures.objective: Verify that reported turnover is complete against accounting records.
steps: Extract revenue per the general ledger for the period.
Extract turnover per the filed tax return(s).
Identify classification differences (exempt/zero-rated vs taxable).
Test year-end cut-off on a sample of transactions.
Conclude on completeness of reported turnover.

exception_conditions: Certificate missing for a claimed credit
Deduction per ledger exceeds certificates held
procedures.expected_result: Withholding credits claimed reconcile to certificates, payments and deposits.
procedures.followup_procedure: Obtain missing certificates; reverse unsupported credits.
procedures.name: Reconcile withholding tax: deductions to certificates and credits
procedures.objective: Agree tax deducted with certificates, deposits and the credit claimed.
steps: List tax deducted per the books by deductee and payment.
Agree each line to a withholding certificate.
Agree deposits to challans and to the tax statement.
Compare the total claimed as credit in the return.
Flag unmatched credits or missing certificates as exceptions.

exception_conditions: Output tax per return differs from registers
Input tax claimed without qualifying invoice
procedures.expected_result: Sales tax records reconcile to accounting records and returns, period by period.
procedures.followup_procedure: Drill into the differing period; correct the return or the books as appropriate.
procedures.name: Reconcile sales tax records to accounting records
procedures.objective: Verify output tax and input tax against books and returns.
steps: Extract output tax and input tax per return for each period.
Extract the same from sales/purchase registers and the ledger.
Compare period by period; list differences.
Verify each difference against source documents.
Conclude and quantify any under/over declaration.

exception_conditions: Payment not traceable to a challan
procedures.expected_result: Every tax payment is evidenced and agrees to the liability.
procedures.followup_procedure: Trace unmatched payments; quantify any shortfall.
procedures.name: Reconcile tax payments to amounts payable
procedures.objective: Agree tax paid with the computed liability.
steps: Take the liability per the tax computation.
List all payments with challan references and dates.
Agree each payment to a bank debit.
Compute the balance payable/(refundable).
Flag short or late payments.

procedures.expected_result: Independently recalculated taxable income agrees to the filed computation.
procedures.followup_procedure: Correct the computation; assess the return impact.
procedures.name: Recalculate taxable income
procedures.objective: Independently recompute taxable income using the verified rules.
steps: Recompute each add-back and deduction from source documents.
Recompute tax depreciation using the verified schedule and rates.
Apply the rate table for the correct tax year.
Compare with the filed computation and investigate differences.

procedures.calculation_method: Apply the verified calc table for the payment's legal category and transaction date to the correct tax base.
exception_conditions: Rate from the wrong period applied
procedures.expected_result: Recalculated withholding agrees to the amount deducted and deposited.
procedures.followup_procedure: Quantify short/excess deduction; check deposit and reporting.
procedures.name: Recalculate withholding tax
procedures.objective: Recompute withholding using the correct legal basis and rate.
steps: Confirm the legal category of the payment and the payer's obligation.
Select the calc table in effect on the payment date.
Determine the correct tax base (gross amount; check inclusions/exclusions).
Recompute the tax and compare with the amount deducted.
Verify deposit and reporting separately.

procedures.calculation_method: Output tax = taxable value × verified rate; input tax only where statutory conditions are satisfied.
exception_conditions: Input tax claimed on an ineligible purchase
procedures.expected_result: Recalculated net tax agrees to the return.
procedures.followup_procedure: Disallow ineligible input tax; correct the period.
procedures.name: Recalculate output tax and eligible input tax
procedures.objective: Recompute sales tax liability from verified records.
steps: Recompute output tax on taxable supplies at the verified rate.
Test each input tax claim against the eligibility conditions.
Exclude duplicates and ineligible claims.
Reflect credit/debit notes in the correct period.
Compare net tax with the return.

exception_conditions: Bank credit with no corresponding revenue entry
Payment that should have attracted withholding but did not
procedures.followup_procedure: Record or explain each exception; extend testing if systemic.
procedures.name: Completeness testing
procedures.objective: Test that recorded transactions are complete in the tax records.
steps: Trace a sample of recorded transactions to tax records.
Compare bank receipts with recorded revenue.
Scan expense/payment populations for items that may trigger withholding obligations.
Inspect year-end transactions for cut-off errors.
Summarise exceptions with potential tax effect.

procedures.expected_result: Each claimed deduction/exemption/credit satisfies its statutory conditions.
procedures.followup_procedure: Reverse or qualify claims that fail the conditions.
procedures.name: Eligibility testing for deductions, exemptions and credits
procedures.objective: Verify that each claim meets its legal conditions.
steps: List every deduction, exemption and credit claimed.
For each, extract the statutory conditions from the linked rule.
Verify supporting documentation exists and is valid.
Check dates, limits and thresholds.
Identify disqualifying conditions and quantify the effect.
